source.title: smedinx-11 is a planarian stem cell gap junction gene required for regeneration and homeostasis

injury: transverse amputation anterior and posterior (regenerating fragments, Fig 3A)

intervention.timing: dsRNA microinjected: 3 injections over 2 days, 1 day rest, 1 more day; amputated 8 days after first injection
intervention.description: Worms injected with smedinx-11 dsRNA, amputated 8 days after first injection, fragments left to regenerate.

readout.method: morphological scoring of blastema / new tissue formation

notes: Fig 3A legend: smedinx-11(RNAi) fragments failed to create new tissue (30/30) even at 3 weeks post-amputation; also scored at 7 dpa (same animals). Fragment type read from the Fig 3A image (cut planes at both ends). Water-injected control fragments formed blastemas but no count is given.

source.title: smedinx-11 is a planarian stem cell gap junction gene required for regeneration and homeostasis

intervention.timing: dsRNA microinjected: 3 injections over 2 days, 1 day rest, 1 more day
intervention.description: Intact, uncut worms injected with smedinx-11 dsRNA and observed over the following weeks.

readout.method: external body morphology of intact worms

notes: Fig 3B legend: at 21 days the lateral and posterior edges of the worms curled under ventrally (50/50) -> morphology_defect. Family chosen as planaria_screen (paper screened all 12 innexins by RNAi; intact-worm morphology endpoint). Later: 13/15 worms showed no head regression at 31 days (possibly a different subset; not used as a separate row); all animals died 35-40 days after first injection (after scoring).
